title: pilosella venosa
intro: Pilosella venosa, commonly known as Field Sow Thistle or Red Sow Thistle, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella venosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, that may help to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Pilosella venosa on human health.
